comingLast.roast: 6 holes left to avoid the double blue - 3 points does it
2 above the cellar - the trapdoor creaks every time he wipes
the escape ladder has 2 rungs - grip well
3 points of insurance at 1.1 a hole - premium unpaid
4 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
the cushion is 5 - more of a coaster really
5 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
above Clarke by 8 - close enough to hear the engraver
11 points from infamy - every 1-pointer counts double now
